text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the specific nature of your gait and limb ataxia, such as when it started and if it has been progressively worsening?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is this clumsiness strictly limited to your right side, or do you notice any coordination issues on your left side as well? Additionally, have you experienced any recent headaches, double vision, or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Natalizumab significantly increases the risk of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), so I need to know if you have experienced any subtle cognitive changes, memory loss, or speech difficulties alongside your motor symptoms. Have you noticed any visual disturbances like blind spots or blurred vision in the past few weeks?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.
